description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to 'Official Roadmaps' in a software project, including fetching roadmap data, listing roadmaps, and checking if a roadmap is new.

methods.name: officialRoadmapOptions
methods.description: Returns query options for fetching an official roadmap by slug.

methods.name: officialRoadmapDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific roadmap by slug, handling 404 errors.

methods.name: listOfficialRoadmaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all official roadmaps, returns empty array if none found.

methods.name: listOfficialBeginnerRoadmaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of beginner roadmaps, returns empty array if none found.

methods.name: isNewRoadmap
methods.description: Determines if a roadmap is considered new based on its creation date (less than 45 days old).
